subject: Recheck your last deal with today's assumptions
preheader: A quick re-check on the one that almost worked.
headline: Still hunting deals?
body: It's been a few weeks since your last TrueCap run. Revisit the financing, rent, tax, insurance, and expense assumptions you used; any of them may be different now.
If you've got a listing sitting in your inbox, paste the address and re-underwrite it in 60 seconds. No spreadsheet, no setup.
And if TrueCap isn't fitting how you invest, just reply and tell me why — it genuinely helps me make it better.
